product: Add aggregations for several Lakeflow Designer columns (Public Preview)
tagline: Select multiple columns when adding an aggregation in Lakeflow Designer.
what_it_does: Select multiple columns when adding an aggregation in Lakeflow Designer. The Aggregate operator creates a separate aggregation for each selected column. Lakeflow Designer includes built in operators for common data preparation and transformation tasks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Select multiple columns when adding an aggregation in Lakeflow Designer. The Aggregate operator creates a separate aggregation for each selected column.
